caption: The drawing depicts a balcony with ornate wrought iron railings and decorative trim, featuring intricate floral and leaf patterns along the vertical and horizontal elements. The balcony occupies the foreground and left side of the image, while the background shows a cityscape with multiple buildings characterized by sloped roofs and a variety of roof shapes. Centrally located in the background is a tall church or cathedral with a prominent spire, surrounded by several chimneys and small rooftop structures. Light clouds are sketched in the sky above the buildings. The artwork uses primarily black ink linework on a beige or off-white paper, with varying line thicknesses to convey texture and depth. There are no visible human figures, and the objects are arranged so the viewer is looking outward from the inside edge of the balcony toward the distant city.
title: Iron Balcony
